data: In fiscal 2023 (year ended June 30, 2023), Microsoft reported revenue of $211,915 million, or about $211.9 billion, up from $198,270 million in fiscal 2022. Gross profit, which the filing labels gross margin, was $146,052 million after $65,863 million in cost of revenue, giving a gross margin of about 68.9%. Operating income was $88,523 million, which works out to an operating margin of about 41.8%. For comparison, fiscal 2022 had a gross margin of roughly 68.4% and an operating margin of roughly 42.1%, so gross margin edged up while operating margin slipped slightly.
